outline.unique_angle: A concrete, first-person, four-item bedside CHECKLIST framed for UK/AU/NZ regulators (NMC code, NMBA, Te Kaunihera accountability — not US HIPAA), with one named real-shift anecdote per check. Top-3 either give a US-HIPAA generic 5-question list (nursechartingpro), a doctor/AHP UK-policy overview (iatrox), or risk-management theory with NO actual checklist (tmlt). None give a nurse's personal, repeatable on-shift sequence with the specific four error classes ordered by danger.

YMYL: this is clinical content. Needs RN byline + reg credential, 1+ citation to a guideline/PubMed (e.g. NMC code, RCN AI position, or a PMC hallucination-rate study), 'last reviewed' date, and 'in my practice / ask your supervisor' framing — no medical advice phrasing.
NMC has no live AI-specific standard until ~Oct 2027; frame UK guidance via existing Code accountability + RCN position, not an invented NMC AI rule.
